tenderSchedule.description: Procurement of 15cm HD Spatial Resolution Mono Satellite Imagery for Bengaluru Region GBA, BDA & BMRDA
tenderSchedule.deptName: Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms e Governance
tenderSchedule.locationName: DPAR eGOV KSRSAC Director Office Bangalore

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and condition has per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Power of Attorney executed by the Bidder in favor of the Principal Officer or duly Authorized Representative, certifying him / her as an authorized signatory for the purpose of this Tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Furnishing of the Power of Attorney

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should be proprietorship firm or registered as a Company registered under Indian Companies Act, 1956 or a partnership firm registered under Indian Partnership Act, 1932 or a Limited Liability Partnership registered under Indian Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008. No Joint Venture andor consortium bid is allowed

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration Certificate issued under the Companies Act 1956 / 2003/LLP Act, 2008 (Certificate of Incorporation/ Certificate of Establishment).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should submit copy of PAN and GST in the name of firm

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of PAN and GST registration certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should necessarily be Indian entity only and empaneled/registered with IN-SPACe /ISRO e- portal

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of empaneled/registered with IN-SPACe /ISRO e- portal

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Authorization letter mentioning Tender reference number should be provided by the OEM / Principal Satellite Data Provider/IN-SPACe - ISRO empaneled or registered Distributer/Reseller which is to be addressed to the Director, KSRSAC.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The Bidder should be an Authorized Indian Distributor/Reseller/Representative of the  (OEM) / Principal Satellite Data Provider

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should submit copy of Income Tax Returns (ITR) filed for preceding three financial year (2022-23 to 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of Income Tax Returns (ITR)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have more than INR.2.0 Crores Audited annual turnover during last three financial years (i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Turn over Certificate from the Chartered Accountant must be submitted with UDIN

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have a positive net worth for latest 3 financial years (i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate from CA with UDIN

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have been supplied any satellite data / imagery to any Central / State Government/ Institutions or Public sector undertakings since last three completed financial years (i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Proof of supplying orders of the same. For each financial year one proof of supply order to be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should not be debarred or blacklisted by any procurement entity in Central Government / State Government and its Departments for indulging in corrupt or fraudulent practices or for indulging in unfair trade practices for any reasons whatsoever at the time of bidding.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- A declaration by the authorized representative of the bidding agency to be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Any bidder from a country that shares a land border with India excluding countries to which the Government of India has extended lines of credit or in which the Government of India is engaged in development projects (as listed on the website of the Ministry of External Affairs) hereinafter called Restricted Countries shall be eligible to participate in this RFP, only if the bidder is registered with the Registration Committee constituted by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-Declaration and necessary documents of proof.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder through its OEM, has to submit a sample data (minimum 5 sq.km.) for inspection and demonstration (as per the instructions) during the technical evaluation, if required. The bidder has to adhere to the data quality parameters as per the technical specifications. (In case of multiple bidders of same OEM, only one sample data shall be submitted by the OEM)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Sample Data should be provided during technical evaluation if required by the Tendering Authority.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Enclose Compliance statement, along with product brochures and technical specifications must be provided

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Compliance statement of technical specifications

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should fill and submit all Annexures mentioned as per RFP document

A Copy of Work Order and Client Completion / Performance / satisfactory reports for each of the projects undertaken to be submitted. The bidder shall also submit completed supply/work order along with payments received from the client against that work/supply order as proof. AND Bidder should have completed a minimum of three (3) work orders for the supply of satellite data, with a total value of not less than INR 2.0 crores in the last 5 years, for any Central / State Government/ Institutions or Public sector undertakings. AND at least a single order of satellite data / imagery above INR.1.0 Crore.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: ALL OTHER REQUIRED DOCUMETS HAS TO BE UPLOADED AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT
